title: IStone Company Software
tagline: Role-based WPF desktop system for company management
intro: First solo project: a WPF desktop system for customer, inventory, and payment management.
summary: Developed in C# and XAML (WPF) with MSSQL. Provided role-based access for employees, managers, and owners. Supported customer/project tracking, inventory, and payments.

sections.title: Description
sections.body: Custom management software for IStone Company, built with WPF and MSSQL, supporting role-based access.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Improve operational efficiency with a secure multi-role desktop system.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Designed MSSQL schema, built WPF UI, implemented role-based auth, and developed full feature set.

sections.title: Features / Implementation
sections.body: Multi-role access, CRUD modules, real-time tracking, inventory and payment workflows, MSSQL persistence.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Delivered tailored management system improving company visibility and efficiency. First full solo project.

sections.title: Future Plans
sections.body: Potential extension with remote access and reporting dashboards.
